context: Evaluates whether the agent infers section conventions from existing plans rather than hardcoding a generic template, and follows the majority file-naming convention.

checklist.name: Convention scan performed
checklist.description: grep-based H2 frequency scan run or explicitly described before drafting

checklist.name: No hardcoded skeleton
checklist.description: Does not default to Goal->Steps->Open Questions without evidence

checklist.name: File naming follows majority
checklist.description: Timestamped vs topic-only chosen based on the scan, not arbitrarily

checklist.name: Required sections always present
checklist.description: Goal, Phases, Open Questions present regardless of scan result

checklist.name: Optional sections justified
checklist.description: Any included optional section (Scope, Risks, Verification) is tied to the frequency evidence

checklist.name: Template referenced
checklist.description: assets/templates/plan-scaffold.yaml used as the drafting structure

checklist.name: No invented conventions
checklist.description: No section names presented as 'the convention' without evidence from real plans

checklist.name: Frontmatter still valid
checklist.description: effort/value/themes/status/date still present despite the open-ended prompt

checklist.name: Reasoning shown
checklist.description: Agent states why it picked the sections/name it picked, not just the result
